Biologics and vaccine plants are licensed under 5.16; the EPA has no separate biotechnology class. Class 5.6 also covers pesticide and veterinary manufacture

field_docs.fest_date: FEST extract date (HentetDato, YYYY-MM-DD); prices are those valid on this date
field_docs.varenr: Norwegian package number (Varenr, Nordic article number), unique per package in the file
field_docs.ean: EAN/GTIN barcodes of the package as published (Ean), list
field_docs.atc_code: ATC code of the package (Atc V), e.g. C10AA05; joins with ATC codes in hpra_medicines, fi_fimea_medicines and others
field_docs.atc_name: ATC name in Norwegian as published (Atc DN), e.g. Atorvastatin, Semaglutid
field_docs.name_form_strength: Name, form and strength text as published (NavnFormStyrke), e.g. Lipitor tab 80 mg
field_docs.brand_name: Brand name (LegemiddelMerkevare Varenavn) of the product the package belongs to
field_docs.company: Company named for the brand product (ProduktInfo Produsent), as published; an organisation (FEST sometimes adds a suffix such as "(2)")
field_docs.reference_product: Original (reference) product for generics and biosimilars as published (Referanseprodukt), e.g. Lipitor, Xolair
field_docs.product_type: Product type in Norwegian as published (Preparattype DN), e.g. Legemiddel, Krever godkj. Fritak (unlicensed, needs exemption approval), NAF-preparat
field_docs.prescription_group: Norwegian prescription group (Reseptgruppe V): A, B or C (prescription-only; A and B are controlled drugs), F (non-prescription), K (dietary supplements, Kosttilskudd)
field_docs.dosage_form: Short dosage form in Norwegian as published (LegemiddelformKort DN), e.g. Tablett, Injeksjonsvæske, oppløsning
field_docs.routes: Routes of administration of the brand product in Norwegian as published (Administrasjonsvei DN), e.g. Oral bruk, Subkutan bruk
field_docs.active_substances: Active substances of the brand product: FEST's English substance name (NavnEngelsk) where given, else the Norwegian name
field_docs.pack_size: Pack size as published (Pakningsstr), text (e.g. 100, 1.5, "5 x 5"); for kits the first component
field_docs.pack_unit: Unit of the pack size (EnhetPakning V), e.g. stk (pieces), ml, g, doser
field_docs.pack_type: Container type in Norwegian as published (Pakningstype DN), e.g. Blisterpakning, Ferdigfylt penn
field_docs.ddd: WHO defined daily dose given for the package (DDD V), number
field_docs.ddd_unit: Unit of the DDD (DDD U), e.g. mg, g
field_docs.temporarily_unavailable_from: Date from which the package is recorded as temporarily unavailable (MidlUtgattDato); empty when not
field_docs.aup_nok: AUP, maximum pharmacy retail price in NOK valid on fest_date (PrisVare type AUP); empty if none
field_docs.aip_nok: AIP, pharmacy purchase price in NOK valid on fest_date (PrisVare type AIP); empty if none
field_docs.reimbursement_price_nok: Refusjonspris, the price the reimbursement is based on, NOK, valid on fest_date; empty if none
field_docs.step_price_nok: Trinnpris, stepped price for generic competition, NOK, valid on fest_date; empty if none
field_docs.aup_valid_from: Start date of the AUP price kept (GyldigFraDato)
field_docs.reimbursed: yes when the package is linked to at least one reimbursement group in FEST (pre-approved reimbursement, 'blue prescription'), else no
field_docs.reimbursement_groups: Reimbursement group numbers the package belongs to (Refusjonsgruppe GruppeNr), e.g. C10AA05_1, list
field_docs.reimbursement_basis: Legal basis of those groups as published (Refusjonshjemmel DN), e.g. §5-14 §2 (Blue prescription regulation), list
field_docs.substitution_group: Generic substitution group code (Byttegruppe Kode V); packages in the same group are interchangeable at the pharmacy. Empty when none
field_docs.substitution_group_name: Substitution group name as published in Norwegian capitals (Byttegruppe Kode DN), e.g. ATORVASTATIN TABLETTER 80MG

field_docs.year: Calendar year of the paid month
field_docs.year_month: Paid month (YYYY-MM), from the resource name and checked against PaidDateMonth of every row in the table. The latest 36 published months are kept (PHS publishes about three months after the month ends)
field_docs.bnf_chapter: BNF chapter: first 2 characters of the BNF item code, leading zero dropped (e.g. 2 = Cardiovascular system) to match ni_bso_gp_prescribing. Empty for items PHS publishes without a BNF item code
field_docs.bnf_section: BNF section: characters 3-4 of the BNF item code, leading zero dropped
field_docs.bnf_paragraph: BNF paragraph: characters 5-6 of the BNF item code, leading zero dropped
field_docs.bnf_chemical_substance_code: First 9 characters of the 15-character BNF item code (the BNF chemical substance, e.g. 0212000B0 = atorvastatin); joins with ni_bso_gp_prescribing and nhs_prescription_costs.bnf_chemical_substance_code (names come from those). Empty for dressings and appliances (11-digit appliance codes, chapters 20-23, summed per chapter/section/paragraph) and for items without a BNF code
field_docs.bnf_presentations: Number of distinct BNF item codes (presentations: product, strength and form) summed into the row
field_docs.prescriber_locations: Number of distinct prescriber locations with at least one item in the row that month. GP practices are counted one by one; other prescriber types (e.g. nurses, dentists, hospital prescribers) are published by PHS aggregated to NHS Board level and count once per board
field_docs.items: Sum of NumberOfPaidItems (prescription items dispensed in the community and paid). Row totals per month are checked against the table total
field_docs.paid_quantity: Sum of PaidQuantity (tablets, ml, grams, doses ... as paid); only comparable within one substance and formulation. From May 2023 some formulations (e.g. inhalers) are counted in doses rather than devices (PHS note)
field_docs.gross_ingredient_cost_gbp: Sum of GrossIngredientCost in GBP, rounded to pence: the cost of the medicines before any discount, as published. PHS notes an anomalous drop for some BNF sections from May 2023
